record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare SPARK in this production reference: Wattrel and Kilowattrel (passive WIND_POWER, maxPP 80, range 2) and Pincurchin (passive PINCURCHIN, maxPP 100, range 1). The strategy is shared; the passives were not analysed here.
record.summary: Chain lightning. The cast target takes SPECIAL damage of 30/60/90 raw by the caster's stars (Wattrel 30, Kilowattrel 60, Pincurchin 90) immediately. A chain then hops: each hop picks the first unit (in board scan order of the 8 cells around the previous victim) that is on the primary target's team and not yet in the hit set, and, 250 ms later, deals SPECIAL damage of ceil(raw / 2^n) to it (n = 1 for the first hop), then hops on from it. The chain stops when no such neighbour exists or after the hop with n = 10. The primary target is never added to the hit set, so a hop can come back to it. The AP value lowered by 20 per hop is only an animation payload; damage uses the caster's full AP on every hit.

targeting.who: primary: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target); chain: units whose team equals the primary target's team, adjacent to the previous victim
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the cast target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.adjacency: all 8 neighbours (including diagonals) of the previous victim's current cell; candidates are examined top row first, left to right; the first eligible one is chosen (no distance, HP or randomness)
geometry.limits: hit set excludes units already chosen as hop victims but not the primary target; at most 10 hops after the primary hit

timing.note: each hop is a DelayedCommand of 250 ms pushed on the caster; SimulationCommand.update runs it once the accumulated dt exceeds the delay, and the caster's own update advances its commands

effects.scaling: every hit: AP x (1 + attacker AP/100) (apBoost true, caster's AP, not reduced per hop); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by each victim's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crits (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT). The same crit flag is used for every hit.
effects.resolution: requested amount per hit (raw for the primary target, ceil(raw/2^n) for hop n) -> AP/crit -> PokemonState.handleDamage (defenses, SPE_DEF division with minimum 1, shield; core-mechanics §A/§H); applied HP loss and takenDamage (shield part included) differ per victim. Hop damage is evaluated when the 250 ms command runs; protect / skydiving / magicBounce victims take no damage and (magicBounce) reflect damage to the caster, but the chain continues from them. The ability reads no takenDamage.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 180 (also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' star counts (1, 2, 3). Pincurchin has stars 3 as its base class.

record.positionalConditions: The hop sequence depends on the primary target's position and the units next to it: the first eligible neighbour in row-major order. With no eligible neighbour only the primary hit happens. The hit set holds hop victims only; because the primary target is not in it, a later hop can select the primary target again when it is the first eligible neighbour of the current victim.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: The hit set is created per cast and not stored. Each cast repeats the primary hit and the chain; chains from different casts are independent. Pending hop commands live on the caster and run through its own update.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 30/60/90 by stars. Requested: primary = raw; hop n = ceil(raw/2^n), e.g. Wattrel 15,8,4,2,1,1,1,1,1,1; Kilowattrel 30,15,8,4,2,1,1,1,1,1; Pincurchin 45,23,12,6,3,2,1,1,1,1. Applied: each requested amount x(1 + caster AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division and the other handleDamage steps per victim; takenDamage includes shield damage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); handleDamage was consulted via core-mechanics §A/§H, not re-probed here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
Whether the caster's command list is still advanced if the caster dies or is removed before a pending hop (only PokemonState.updateCommands was read)
unresolved: The routing queue record lists no routing uncertainties; Wattrel, Kilowattrel and Pincurchin are the only units listed for this identifier
The passives WIND_POWER (Wattrel, Kilowattrel) and PINCURCHIN were not read; if either changes SPARK, that is not covered
Hop targets are selected at cast time for the first hop and when each earlier hop runs for later ones; positions that change in between were not simulated
Whether any item or synergy changes SPARK beyond what is listed
No pinned-helper probe was run for this record; the chain was read, not executed
